note: A SCULPTED body on its own ground (spec-0087). `prefab/gallery-carcass` is not generated by the gallery generator or a grammar program: `tools/ci/gallery-prefabs.py` sculpts it with `delvec sculpt` from `gallery/forms/gallery-carcass.json`, a form of implicit solids over a mud apron that fills the piece's footprint. It needs ground under every column it can be walked off — on the primary's `void` its open apron is a void drop (`DW0322`) — so it stands on the base that builds terrain, seated by the walk plane the sculpt measured. The one quest walks it end to end: in through the wound in the west flank at grade to the room inside, floored by the apron and lit by the form's one lantern, then out and up the shelf cut into the east flank onto the back. So this build's `DW0921` ledger, `DW0210` survey and `piece-exposure.json` bind over a sculpted body, and `DW0311` walks its inside and its back. It carries its own quest plan, quests, layout graph and classes (the valley site's, with no flask, for the reason that point gives), and its own cameras at eyes this world keeps clear.
